name: senderdeck
description: Open-source email and brand conversation tools for Codex and Claude. Google and Microsoft mailboxes, customer workspaces and explicit reply approvals, with a gated Meta social module.

interface.longDescription:
SenderDeck is an MIT-licensed, open-source workspace for email and brand conversations through Codex or Claude. Connect up to 10 Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 accounts per user. Search and read on demand, download attachments, select authorised Gmail aliases and create, update and inspect provider-hosted drafts. Email sending requires a separate confirmation of the exact sender, recipients, subject, attachments and current revision.

Customer and brand workspaces add role controls, language and tone settings, source-labelled verified facts, escalation rules, enquiry ownership and an activity feed. Social history snapshots and immutable local drafts are encrypted and expire. Replies require approval of the exact brand, account, target, text and revision.

Facebook and Instagram adapters are implemented, but live access requires platform approval, owner consent, verified assets and subscriptions, and a working hosted scheduler. Social sending and hosted monitoring are not active in the current deployment. LinkedIn community access and Page messaging, Instagram mentions and social attachment sending remain unavailable pending approval or validation. Coverage gaps are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Search my connected inboxes for recent action items.
Draft a reply from the selected account and wait for my approval.
Show the selected brand and its available social capabilities.
Review this brand’s verified facts and escalation rules.
